purpose: Reproducible configuration + metric schema for the joint size+timing evaluation (plan Phase 7). Defines WHAT is evaluated and HOW it is scored. Contains NO results.

configurations.expect: separate-ACK CLRT feature collapsed; residual req->resp timing/size/ACK-mode
response held to ACK-relative deadline; residual size/ACK-mode
response size normalized (see size_inventory); residual timing/ACK-mode
timing AND size normalized; residual = ACK-mode (C-RESID)

scoring_rules.chance_level: 1/k where k = number of device/class labels
scoring_rules.defense_success: post-defense balanced accuracy CI CONTAINS chance AND a distributional-equivalence check passes
scoring_rules.grouped_cv: MANDATORY — never split the same session/run/replay across train and test
scoring_rules.joint_honesty_split: report TWO numbers for combined: (a) timing+size subset -> target chance; (b) all-features -> floored at the ACK-mode residual
scoring_rules.unit_of_analysis: one independent hardware run; report n_independent_hardware_runs and n_classifier_resamples separately
scoring_rules.no_mode_hiding_claim: do not claim ACK-mode hidden unless a mechanism actually hides it (currently residual)

provenance_rules.no_manufactured_results: metrics run only on real per-run feature tables or clearly-labeled synthetic fixtures
provenance_rules.current_status: analysis code offline-verified on synthetic fixtures; NO real defended hardware runs exist yet (dp8 blocked)
